root = Card("expense_review", "Vendor Compliance Renewal", content)
content = Stack("review_content", [identity, status_filter, expenses, note, approve, result])
identity = Text("review_identity", "Review vendor expenses with clear identity, pending status, and an auditable reviewer note.")
status_filter = Select("status_filter_control", "Status", "status_filter", ["all", "pending", "approved"], "pending")
expenses = Table("expense_table", ["expense_id", "merchant", "amount", "status"], [{"expense_id": "exp-001", "merchant": "Secure Archive Renewal", "amount": "EUR 1,260.00", "status": "pending"}, {"expense_id": "exp-002", "merchant": "Records Storage", "amount": "EUR 340.00", "status": "pending"}])
note = Input("review_note_input", "Reviewer note", "review_note", "")
approve = Button("approve_exp001", "Approve Secure Archive Renewal", {"name": "ApproveExpense", "expense_id": "exp-001"})
result = Alert("approval_result", "success", "Expense exp-001 approved.")
